decisions.reason: Placing the master power control on the front panel does not change the power source, electrical capacity, or component ratings.
The dispense buttons are only spatial references for the master power control placement; their solenoid actuation behavior remains unchanged.
The master power control placement does not change the cursive K marking requirement, which is separately established by another clause in the source message.
The master power control placement does not alter the spouts' location, orientation, geometry, or fabrication style.
The control placement decision does not change any splash-control target or method.
Locating the master power control between the dispense buttons does not change reliability or electrical load-capacity requirements.
The source decision establishes control placement but does not change any enclosure, platform, or accent color.
The front-panel master power control placement does not change placard text, faces, or viewer orientation.
The placement of the master power control does not affect motor speed limits or variable-speed behavior.
The master power control placement has no necessary effect on smoothness, frothiness, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The source decision does not change any food-contact material requirement.
The selected location of the master power control does not necessarily change the V1 component-sourcing or custom-spout strategy.
